text_block_list.name: Shadow Golshi
text_block_list.text:
ORA ORA ORAAAAH!!
Get over here!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オラオラオラーーーーッ！！
こっちこいやーーーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Wrath Golshi and Shadow Golshi?!
But we already defeated them...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ラースゴルシに、
シャドウゴルシ！？
倒したはずじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I can tell.
That one's another being born from me...
If I absorb it, Golshi-chan will become Perfect Golshi-chan...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
アタシにはわかるぜ。
アイツもまた、
アタシを基に生まれた存在……
こいつを吸収すりゃあ、
ゴルシちゃんは
パーフェクトゴルシちゃんに……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
What kind of nonsense is that supposed to be?!
Ugh, I'm getting more and more confused...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやどういう設定よ！？
あーもう、
わけわかんなくなってきたわ……！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's defeat them quickly
before they can cause any more trouble!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とりあえず
また暴れられないように
早く倒しましょう！
